card.name: Linking words before descriptive terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as by, of, and, even, or an opening parenthesis, in general web prose where a descriptive noun or adjective is expected next. Also a few cases of the Chinese character 新 inside a Chinese title.

modes.label: Linking words before a list
modes.description: A short linking word like by, of or and sits just before a list of traits or qualities.
modes.example: Chronic injuries are generally characterized<< by>> stiffness, numbness, discomfort and dull

modes.label: Linking words in paired phrases
modes.description: Words like and or even join two adjectives or nouns in a flowing sentence.

modes.description: The character 新 appears in a Chinese form of a movement's name.

card.plain: It fires on little connecting words like by, of and and, right before a descriptive term or list.
